messages.subject: [Rspatial-devel] Difficulty installing 'sp' (& as a result everything else).
messages.subject_clean: [Rspatial-devel] Difficulty installing 'sp' (& as a result everything else).
messages.body_plain:
I cannot seem to succeed in installing 'sp' (& therefore anything that
depends on it) despite trying more than ten mirrors &
http://R-Forge.R-project.org from within R. I've tried to install
classInt & succeeded halfways through these multiple attempts to
install 'sp'. I'd appreciate even a confirmation that 'sp' is
installable from any given repos. It's likely something really
stupidly simple that I am or am not doing, so I would love to rule out
that for some reason 'sp' is not accessible (which I suspect is
extremely unlikely).

Regards & thanks in advance,
K

messages.body_plain:
Edzer & others,

thanks for the quick response & sorry if signing K caused offense.
I tried install.packages("sp") many times, resetting repos using
options("repos"=c(CRAN="@CRAN@")), trying all the French, German & UK
repos, New Zealand, Ireland (where I'm from), plus several others (in
North & South America). As I've said, I've had no issues installing
recently (bitops, RCurl... I installed classInt around halfways into
my attempts installing sp).
Response invariably is:
Warning message:
In getDependencies(pkgs, dependencies, available, lib) :
  package ?sp? is not available
sessionInfo() currently produces:
R version 2.11.1 (2010-05-31) 
i486-pc-linux-gnu 

locale:
 [1] LC_CTYPE=en_IE.utf8       LC_NUMERIC=C             
 [3] LC_TIME=en_IE.utf8        LC_COLLATE=en_IE.utf8    
 [5] LC_MONETARY=C             LC_MESSAGES=en_IE.utf8   
 [7] LC_PAPER=en_IE.utf8       LC_NAME=C                
 [9] LC_ADDRESS=C              LC_TELEPHONE=C           
[11] LC_MEASUREMENT=en_IE.utf8 LC_IDENTIFICATION=C      

attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base  
  

other attached packages:
[1] classInt_0.1-19 e1071_1.6-1     class_7.3-2    

loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
[1] tcltk_2.11.1 tools_2.11.1
On the off chance that loading RCurl would make any difference, I did
& got the same response as previous, this time from Canada (ON).

Regards,
Kevin.
